rv.q: The entire off-its-rocker off-Broadway show, whose sole sin is occasionally trying too hard, is lovably loony.
Zak has nudged them to yell every line at the top of their lungs so trippingly on the tongue that any number of his jokes(?) are lost in the gibble-gabble-gargle.
While ‘Ginger Twinsies’ may riff on familiar territory—identical twins separated at birth—Kevin Zak’s wicked sense of humor and fearless execution make it wholly, deliciously unique.
The jokes and references all zoom by — which is perhaps just as well given that the percentage of punchlines that actually hit the funny bone is relatively low.
